general.title: Couples Are Bringing AI Into Their Arguments
general.summary: Bloomberg Weekend senior writer Morgan Meaker tells Bloomberg This Weekend how people are increasingly turning to AI chatbots for advice, validation and even mediation during arguments with their partners. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Meaker explores when AI can improve communication and when introducing a digital “third entity” risks creating distance between couples. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: David Cameron Sees Hope in Alzheimer’s Research
general.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, former UK Prime Minister David Cameron discusses the personal toll of losing his mother to Alzheimer’s and the accelerating search for better diagnostics, treatments and ultimately a cure. Cameron tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini about promising drug research, the potential of blood tests to transform diagnosis and why governments should move faster to support clinical trials and expand access to new treatments. general.title: Ukraine Peace Push Turns to NATO and Donbas
general.summary: Bloomberg Economics defense lead Becca Wasser tells Bloomberg This Weekend that a US proposal linking NATO membership to Ukrainian concessions in the Donbas represents movement in peace talks but faces significant political and security hurdles. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Wasser also examines Ukraine’s battlefield pressures and how the US could reshape its military presence in the Middle East after the war with Iran. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Air Travel Chaos Puts FAA Systems in Focus
general.summary: Bloomberg Intelligence senior airlines analyst George Ferguson tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the nationwide ground stop underscores the difficulty of modernizing an aging US air traffic control system while keeping flights moving safely. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ferguson explains why upgrading legacy technology is so complicated and how airlines face the challenge of restoring schedules after thousands of cancellations and delays.
